# Platform-portable tests which run on `windows` (a temporary allowlist: one path - file or dir - per line).
# TODO: TODO_50_98_96_87.support_windows.md: "Test suite hardcodes POSIX path separators ..." - fixing the remaining tests
# moves them here (the plan is in that file); once the whole `pytest` passes, this list is replaced by a plain `pytest`.
# Selection: tests which did not fail in the first full Windows run (PR #193, `python` 3.11) and were not changed since,
# plus the platform-aware tests added later. Tests with `/`-rooted path literals (e.g. "/abs/path") are not in the list:
# they only passed on `python` 3.11 (`ntpath.isabs("/abs/path")` is `False` since 3.13).
